svg.title: Hand: intrinsic muscles, palmar view
svg.desc: Right hand, palmar view, palmar aponeurosis removed. Thumb side (thenar: abductor pollicis brevis lateral, flexor pollicis brevis medial) at the viewer's left; little-finger side (hypothenar: abductor digiti minimi) at the viewer's right. Lumbricals are slender bellies arising from the flexor digitorum profundus tendons.
